concerns.text: US-1 (Data Acquisition and Preprocessing) lacks explicit success criteria anchoring. While FR-001 through FR-014 support it, no SC explicitly names US-1. SC-001 references US-1 but is the only one; consider adding SC-001 reference to FR-003, FR-004, FR-014 for clarity.

FR-028 references 'NEEDS CLARIFICATION' flag but this is a planning-stage marker, not a runtime requirement. Clarify whether the system MUST abort if variables are missing (like FR-022) or merely log and proceed with available data.

SC-002 anchors to US-2 and FR-017 but does not reference FR-002 (the requirement that ≥30 paired participants exist). If structural centrality completeness is measured at ≥95%, this assumes the 30-participant threshold is met; add explicit dependency or clarify fallback.

Assumption states 'All statistical results (p-values, effect sizes) are computed directly from the processed dataset during execution; no hardcoded, simulated, or placeholder values are used for any research results.' This is a RESTATEMENT of FR-023, not an assumption. Move to FR-023 rationale or remove to avoid duplication.

FR-025 requires 'power analysis or explicitly report observed sample size and its implication for statistical power.' This is vague: MUST the system compute post-hoc power (e.g., via G*Power output), or is a narrative statement sufficient? Clarify the deliverable format.

MediationResult entity lists 'direct effect, indirect effect, total effect, confidence intervals, and p-values' but does not specify whether these are per-threshold (given FR-026 sensitivity sweep) or only for the primary model. Clarify scope.
